description: The agent-driven shielded spending flow on the public LEZ testnet at RISC0_DEV_MODE=0: the agent's own shielded account receives 100 tokens (proof-bearing mint), spends 10 autonomously within its per-tx limit (proof-bearing send, balance 100 -> 90), and holds a 75-token over-limit request for the owner without submitting anything. Every transaction below is PrivacyPreserving (type byte 0x01) and carries a real Groth16 proof in its witness set.

transactions.name: spend-03
